About China Massage Guide

Our Mission

China Massage Guide exists to bridge the gap between ancient Chinese therapeutic traditions and modern evidence-based understanding. We provide independent, research-backed educational content about Chinese massage (Tui Na), acupressure, and Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) — free from commercial influence or practitioner referrals.

Every claim on this site cites a peer-reviewed study. We do not accept advertising or sponsored content from massage clinics or product manufacturers.

About the Author

Li Wei, TCM Practitioner

Registered TCM Practitioner | Specializing in Tui Na and Acupressure

Li Wei is a licensed Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioner with over a decade of clinical experience in therapeutic bodywork. She holds a diploma in TCM from the Beijing University of Chinese Medicine and is registered with the Chinese Medicine Board.

Her practice focuses on evidence-informed Tui Na, combining classical meridian theory with contemporary musculoskeletal research. She has contributed to patient education initiatives aimed at making TCM accessible to English-speaking audiences.

Li Wei is committed to transparency: she does not receive referral fees from clinics or product manufacturers, and her clinical recommendations are guided solely by patient need and available evidence.

Our Editorial Standards

  • Every article is reviewed for clinical accuracy by qualified TCM practitioners
  • All health claims cite peer-reviewed research with PubMed-indexed references
  • We clearly distinguish between established evidence and traditional theory
  • Content is updated at least annually to reflect current research
  • We disclose any updates or corrections with modification dates
